findings.mass_formula: retain v1 clipped conditional p, multiply both alternatives by Z=sum geometry_only_mass*absolute_free_likelihood; no renormalization of Z and no second free-likelihood factor

limitations: Heuristic free-consistency attenuation is not calibrated applicability or third-class inference. Unknown extents are unpenalized.
Pooling assumes acquired support tracks are correct; inherited size eligibility can newly skip a pooled large object and all such skipped_pooled_groups must be reported.
No claim that geometry or semantic prior improves decisions follows from unit tests, model mass reduction, or a changed G/S winner.
Diagnostic 6states/66branches reuse one controlled floorplan and two object permutations, not independent new policy trials.
S_no_applicability in future run.py keeps relative free evidence and ablates absolute Z only; S_no_history disables measured-surface consumption, not valid-free-space rejection.
